The successful candidate will be responsible for providing Level 2 network support, managing Cisco routers and switches, administering LAN/WAN and wireless networks, troubleshooting network connectivity issues, and maintaining firewall and VPN configurations. The role requires strong hands-on experience in enterprise networking, network monitoring, incident management, and troubleshooting. The candidate will also work closely with internal IT teams, security teams, cloud teams, network service providers, and other stakeholders to ensure network availability, stability, and performance. Key Responsibilities Administer and maintain enterprise LAN, WAN, wireless, and perimeter network infrastructure across data centres, headquarters, and regional offices. Configure, manage, and troubleshoot Cisco routers, switches, Wireless LAN Controllers (WLC), and Access Points (APs). Manage VLANs, trunking, Spanning Tree Protocol (STP), routing protocols (OSPF/BGP), QoS, NAT, and IP addressing. Administer firewall configurations, security policies, Access Control Lists (ACLs), site-to-site VPNs, and remote-access VPN connectivity. Support and troubleshoot SD-WAN and enterprise network connectivity where required. Monitor network performance, availability, latency, bandwidth utilisation, and packet loss. Use network monitoring and diagnostic tools such as SNMP, NetFlow, Zabbix, Nagios, Grafana, and packet analysis tools to identify and resolve network issues. Handle L2 network incidents, service requests, and changes in accordance with defined SLAs and ITSM processes. Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and provide technical recommendations to prevent recurring network incidents. Maintain network documentation, topology diagrams, IP address plans, configuration backups, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and CMDB records. Coordinate with Internet Service Providers (ISPs), managed network service providers, cloud teams, security teams, and on-site engineers to resolve complex network issues. Support network upgrades, configuration changes, infrastructure maintenance, and implementation activities. Ensure network security, availability, reliability, and compliance with established infrastructure standards. Mandatory Technical Skills & Requirements 4–8 years of hands-on experience in network administration, network infrastructure support, or network operations. Strong experience in enterprise LAN/WAN administration across data centres and corporate office environments. Hands-on experience with Cisco routers, switches, Wireless LAN Controllers (WLC), and Access Points (APs) . Strong understanding of VLAN, trunking, STP, routing, QoS, NAT, and IP addressing. Good knowledge of routing protocols such as OSPF and BGP. Hands-on experience with firewall administration, VPN connectivity, ACLs, and network security policies. Experience in network monitoring and troubleshooting using SNMP, NetFlow, Zabbix, Nagios, Grafana, or similar tools. Good understanding of network troubleshooting methodologies and packet analysis. Experience in incident, change, and problem management using ITSM tools. Familiarity with Symphony Summit for incident and service request management. Strong knowledge of SLA management, escalation procedures, and root cause analysis. Good-to-Have Skills Experience with SD-WAN technologies and enterprise network connectivity. Exposure to multi-cloud networking across Tencent Cloud, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS, and Microsoft Azure. Knowledge of network automation using Python, Ansible, or REST APIs. Familiarity with Cloudflare Zero Trust, WAF/CDN, and Check Point CloudGuard. Knowledge of micro-segmentation and virtual networking using VMware NSX-T. Relevant Cisco certifications such as CCNA or CCNP would be an advantage. Required Competencies Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to resolve complex network issues. Good understanding of enterprise network architecture and infrastructure operations. Ability to work independently and handle L2 technical escalations. Good communication and coordination skills when working with internal and external stakeholders. Ability to manage multiple incidents and prioritise tasks based on business impact and SLA requirements. Proactive approach to identifying network risks and preventing recurring issues. Willingness to work on-site in Indonesia and participate in scheduled maintenance or support activities when required.
